item.title: [BUG] MCP tool `understand_image` detected by server but not exposed to AI agent (Builder with MCP / SOLO mode)
item.body:
## 🐛 Bug Description

The MiniMax MCP server connects successfully and both tools (`web_search` and `understand_image`) are detected correctly. However, the AI agent can only invoke `web_search` — `understand_image` is never called, even when explicitly requested.

## Environment

- **IDE:** Trae AI (Windows)
- - **OS:** Windows 10
- - - **Mode tested:** Builder with MCP, SOLO
- - - - **MCP Server:** MiniMax (`minimax-coding-plan-mcp` via `uvx`)
- - - - - **Tools detected:** 2 (`web_search`, `understand_image`)
## MCP Configuration

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "MiniMax": {
      "command": "C:\\Users\\<user>\\.local\\bin\\uvx.exe",
      "args": ["minimax-coding-plan-mcp", "-y"],
      "env": {
        "MINIMAX_API_KEY": "<redacted>",
        "MINIMAX_API_HOST": "https://api.minimax.io",
        "MINIMAX_MCP_BASE_PATH": "C:\\temp\\minimax",
        "MINIMAX_API_RESOURCE_MODE": "local"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Tool Signatures (from `server.py`)

Both tools use only primitive `str` parameters — no binary or special types:

```python
def web_search(query: str) -> TextContent: ...

def understand_image(prompt: str, image_source: str) -> TextContent: ...
```

## Logs — Server connects and detects both tools ✅

```
2026-04-04T09:16:40.048-05:00 [info] MCPServerManager#start Connected.
2026-04-04T09:16:40.054-05:00 [info] MCPServerManager#listTools Got tools: web_search, understand_image
2026-04-04T10:01:53.794-05:00 [info] MCPServerManager#listTools Got tools: web_search, understand_image
```

## Behavior Matrix

| Component | Status |
|---|---|
| MCP server connection | ✅ Connected |
| Tool detection (`web_search`) | ✅ Detected |
| Tool detection (`understand_image`) | ✅ Detected |
| Agent invokes `web_search` | ✅ Works |
| Agent invokes `understand_image` | ❌ Never invoked |

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Configure MiniMax MCP server as shown above
2. 2. Verify server shows `Connected` in Trae MCP panel
3. 3. Verify both tools appear in the MCP tool list
4. 4. In Builder with MCP chat, send: _"Use understand_image to analyze this image: C:\temp\minimax\photo.jpg"_
5. 5. Agent does not invoke `understand_image`
## Expected Behavior

The agent should invoke `understand_image` with `prompt` and `image_source` parameters when requested, just as it does with `web_search`.

## Hypothesis

Based on the v1.4.0 roadmap mentioning upcoming image context support, it appears Trae may be filtering out tools that involve image processing at the agent layer, even when those tools use only standard `str` parameters in their schema.

This is consistent with a cross-IDE pattern reported elsewhere:
- anthropics/claude-code#11448
- - github/copilot-cli#191
- - - JetBrains YouTrack LLM-20454
## Related Issues

- #1057 — Agent does not accurately select specific MCP tools by context
- - #1344 — MCP tool limit of 40 may cause tool deprioritization
## Request

Please expose **all detected MCP tools** to the agent regardless of their name or inferred purpose. Tool filtering decisions should remain with the LLM, not the MCP client layer.
